# entrepot_cleanup_policy (Resource)

A cleanup policy deletes components matching **all** of its set criteria from the repositories that list it in `cleanup_policies`. Use the server's preview endpoint (or the UI) for a dry run before attaching a policy.

A policy cannot be deleted while repositories use it; when repositories reference the policy resource, Terraform updates them first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Delete npm pre-releases older than 30 days, keeping the 3 newest versions.
resource "entrepot_cleanup_policy" "npm_prereleases" {
  name        = "npm-prereleases"
  description = "Remove old release candidates"
  format      = "npm"
  criteria = {
    published_older_than_days = 30
    prerelease_only           = true
    keep_latest               = 3
  }
}

# Remove untagged Docker manifests after a week.
resource "entrepot_cleanup_policy" "docker_untagged" {
  name     = "docker-untagged"
  format   = "docker"
  criteria = { untagged_older_than_days = 7 }
}

resource "entrepot_repository" "npm" {
  name             = "npm-internal"
  format           = "npm"
  kind             = "hosted"
  blob_store       = "default"
  cleanup_policies = [entrepot_cleanup_policy.npm_prereleases.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria` (Attributes) What to delete. At least one criterion is required; all set criteria must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--criteria))
- `name` (String) Policy name. Changing it forces a new policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `format` (String) Restrict the policy to repositories of one format (`raw`, `pypi`, `npm`, `docker`, `apt`, `yum`, `helm`). Unset: any format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `repositories` (List of String) Repositories that currently use the policy (informational). It changes when repositories are configured and is refreshed on every read; it never causes a diff.

<a id="nestedatt--criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `criteria`

Optional:

- `keep_latest` (Number) Always keep this many newest versions of each component.
- `last_downloaded_older_than_days` (Number) Components last downloaded more than this many days ago (never-downloaded components count from their publish date).
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the component name must match.
- `prerelease_only` (Boolean) Only versions with a pre-release part (`1.2.0-rc.1`, `1.0.0.dev3`).
- `published_older_than_days` (Number) Components published more than this many days ago.
- `untagged_older_than_days` (Number) Docker only: delete untagged manifests (and unreferenced layers) older than this many days.
- `version_regex` (String) Go regular expression the version must match.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cleanup policies are imported by name.
terraform import entrepot_cleanup_policy.npm_prereleases npm-prereleases
```
